en.headline: HK Marathon 2027 sets record 78,000 main-race quota
en.dek: Half-marathon places rise by 4,000 to 29,000; new 5 km harbourfront run and expanded youth event bring total two-day participation to 84,000.
body: The Standard Chartered Hong Kong Marathon will stage its largest edition yet in 2027, with organisers announcing a record main-race quota of 78,000 participants for the event on 17 January.

The increase is driven mainly by a 16 per cent expansion of the half-marathon category, which rises by 4,000 places to 29,000. Full-marathon and 10 km quotas remain at 18,000 and 31,000 respectively. A new 5 km Harbourfront Run at Kai Tak Sports Park, open to all ages and abilities and limited to 3,000 runners, plus an expanded youth run for ages 10–15 with 3,000 places, will be held the day before, bringing overall two-day participation to 84,000.

Organisers said the expansion responds to strong demand after last year’s registration attracted about 120,000 applicants. To manage numbers, the half-marathon will add an extra starting wave and road closures on Nathan Road have been extended. Public ballot registration opens at 2 pm on 11 September.
The Marathon Expo at Kai Tak Arena will again be open to the public. Age-group categories and disability entries remain unchanged.

zh.headline: 2027渣馬主賽事名額破紀錄達78,000
zh.dek: 半馬名額增4,000至29,000；新增5公里海濱跑及擴大少年跑，兩日總參與人數料達84,000。
body: 渣打香港馬拉松2027年將於1月17日舉行，主賽事名額增至歷來最高的78,000個，成為規模最大一屆。
增幅主要來自半馬拉松，名額較上屆增加4,000個至29,000，增幅16%。全馬及10公里名額維持18,000及31,000。新增「五公里海濱跑」於啟德體育園舉行，名額3,000，適合各年齡及能力人士；同日「躍動少年跑」名額亦由2,500增至3,000，供10至15歲青少年參加。連同主賽事，兩日總參與人數預計達84,000。
大會指去年約12萬人報名，反應踴躍，故擴大名額。半馬將增加一場起步，彌敦道路封時間亦獲延長以疏導人流。公眾抽籤報名將於9月11日下午2時開始。
啟德體育館馬拉松博覽會將繼續開放予公眾。年齡組別及傷健人士報名安排維持不變。
